title: A doubled Gordon threshold for palindromic quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators
summary: We consider one-frequency quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators \[ (H_{v,α,θ}u)(n) = u(n+1)+u(n-1) + v(θ+nα)u(n) \] acting on $\ell^2(\mathbb Z)$, where $α\notin\mathbb Q$ and $v\in C^2(\mathbb T,\mathbb R)$ is an even function. We develop a new Gordon-type method that exploits approximate repetitions and palindromic symmetries simultaneously. Denote by $L(E)$ the Lyapunov exponent and let \[β(α) = \limsup_{|k|\to\infty} -\frac{\log\|kα\|_{\mathbb R/\mathbb Z}}{|k|}. \] We prove that, for every completely resonant phase $2θ\inα\mathbb Z+\mathbb Z$, $E$ cannot be an eigenvalue if $L(E)<2β(α)$.…
